items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: He was playing in Philadelphia, and during rehearsals, we had to get some music for him.

ctx.x: He was playing in Philadelphia, and during rehearsals, we had to get some music for him. And they started to jiving around, and that's how "Rockin' in Rhythm" came about.
Is it really? So it was born to back up a dancer, then.
